warnings.descriptionIs: Norðan 15-23 m/s og snjókoma eða skafrenningur, einkum á fjallvegum. Víða lítið skyggni og erfið færð.
warnings.descriptionEn: North 15-23 m/s and blowing snow, mainly on mountain roads. Poor visibility and difficult driving conditions in many places.

warnings.descriptionIs: Norðvestan 13-20 m/s og snjókoma eða skafrenningur, einkum á fjallvegum norðantil. Takmarkað eða lítið skyggni og varasöm færð.
warnings.descriptionEn: Northwest 13-20 m/s and blowing snow, mainly on mountain roads in the north. Limited visibility and adverse driving conditions in places.

warnings.descriptionIs: Hægt minnkandi norðanátt og dregur úr ofankomu. Líkur á slæmu skyggni og erfiðari færð. Ökumenn kanni vel veðurspá og færð áður en lagt er af stað.
warnings.descriptionEn: Slowly decreasing northerly winds and lesser snow. Poor visibility and difficult driving conditions. Travellers check carefully weather forecasts and road conditions before embarking on a journey.

warnings.descriptionIs: Vestan og norðvestan 15-23 m/s og snjókoma eða skafreningur. Lítið skyggni og erfið færð, einkum á Tröllaskaga og fjallvegum. Ökumenn kanni vel veðurspá og færð áður en lagt er af stað.
warnings.descriptionEn: West and north 15-23 m/s and blowing snow. Poor visibility and difficult driving conditions, mainly on mountain roads. Travellers check carefully weather forecasts and road conditions before embarking on a journey.

warnings.descriptionEn: North 18-25 m/s and blowing snow, mainly on mountain roads. Poor visibility and difficult driving conditions in many places.

warnings.descriptionEn: North 15-23 m/s and blowing snow, mainly on mountain roads. Poor visibility and difficult driving conditions in many places.

warnings.descriptionIs: Vaxandi vestan og norðvestanátt, 15-23 m/s síðdegis og snjókoma eða skafreningur. Lítið skyggni og erfið færð, einkum á Tröllaskaga og fjallvegum. Ökumenn kanni vel veðurspá og færð áður en lagt er af stað.

warnings.descriptionIs: Norðan 18-25 m/s og talsverð snjókoma með skafrenningur, einkum á fjallvegum og á Tröllaskaga. Ferðalög ekki ráðlögð.
warnings.descriptionEn: North 18-25 m/s and considerable blowing snow, mainly on Trollaskagi and on mountain roads. Travel not advised.

warnings.descriptionEn: Increasing northwest wind with snow, 13-20 late afternoon. Travellers check carefully weather forecasts and road conditions before embarking on a journey.

warnings.descriptionEn: North 18-25 m/s and considerable blowing snow, mainly on mountain roads and on Trollaskagi. Travel not advised.

warnings.descriptionEn: Slowly decreasing northerly winds and lesser snow, first in the west. Poor visibility and difficult driving conditions. Travellers check carefully weather forecasts and road conditions before embarking on a journey.

warnings.headlineEn: Northwest severe gales to full storm
warnings.descriptionIs: Norðvestan 18-25 m/s með vindhhviður að 45-50 m/s, einkum austan Öræfa. Staðbundið tjón getur orðið á mannvirkjum og fólk því hvatt til að halda sig innandyra. Ráðið er frá ferðalögum.
warnings.descriptionEn: Northwest 18-25 m/s with wind gusts reaching 45-50 m/s. Local damage on infrastructure can occur and people are therefore advised to stay inside. Travel is hazardous.
